rows.grounds: numeral element forming the count with 'sahasreṣu'
locative indicating the vast number in which torment occurs
compound denoting the loci or devices of birth
describes the afflicted state of beings within those loci

items.question: Within how many womb-mechanisms are beings subjected to torment?
premises: The count specified is eighty-four thousand.
The loci of affliction are womb-mechanisms.
Beings within these loci are tormented.
items.inference: Beings are tormented within eighty-four thousand womb-mechanisms.
uncertainties: The subject experiencing torment is implied from context rather than explicitly stated in this verse.
items.plain_english: They are tormented in the eighty-four thousand womb-mechanisms.
